Clean pass with two caveats. (1) The anchors were administered on a 0-5 scale (the .sav value labels read '0 = Strongly disagree' .. '5 = Strongly agree', and the paper says participants 'answered on a 0-to-5 scale'), but the SPSS codes -- and therefore IRW resp -- run 1-6. option_text ships the anchor wording with the source label's leading '0 = '..'5 = ' numbering stripped, so resp is one higher than the number respondents saw. (2) The study publishes no instruction text for the scale in either the paper or the S1 .sav, so instructions is left blank rather than supplied from a canonical rendering of the AICS.

Administered in Finnish; item_text/option_text carry the Finnish the respondents read, verbatim from PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0207706 S1 Table (pone.0207706.s001.pdf), with the _translated columns holding English. Line breaks in the PDF were rejoined; nothing else was altered.

instructions is deliberately BLANK. S1 Table publishes the 26 Finnish items and the Finnish Likert anchors but no Finnish instruction text, and Neff's English instructions ('HOW I TYPICALLY ACT TOWARDS MYSELF IN DIFFICULT TIMES / Please read each statement carefully...') were not what this sample read. Shipping them would invent an administered string.

option_text_translated is MIXED provenance. resp=1 'Hardly ever' and resp=5 'Almost always' are the study's own English for the W1 endpoints (S1 Table: "Finnish translation of the Likert scale used in W1 (From 1 (“Hardly ever”) to 5 (“Almost always”)"). The study printed no English for resp 2-4, so 'Very rarely' / 'Neither often nor rarely' / 'Very often' were rendered by IRW from the Finnish. item_text_translated is entirely the study's own English.

The W1 anchor set is used because the IRW table is wave 1 only -- data/kumlander_2018_self_compassion.py ships pone.0207706.s006.sav alone and deliberately drops s007.sav (wave 2, no linking id). S1 Table prints a DIFFERENT W2 anchor set (1=Hyvin harvoin, 2=Toisinaan, 3=Noin puolet ajasta, 4=Melko usein, 5=Lahes aina); it does not apply to this table and is not shipped.
